en.headline: Man rescued after charcoal burning at Sai Kung campsite
en.dek: Police found a 30-year-old man unconscious in a tent at Tai Mong Tsai campsite early Saturday after a Threads post prompted a report; he later regained consciousness.
body: Police said they received a report at about 12.40am on Saturday after people saw a post on Threads in which a man said he was burning charcoal at Tai Mong Tsai campsite in Sai Kung and asked others to call the police.
Officers found a 30-year-old man surnamed Wong unconscious inside a tent with burnt charcoal nearby. He was taken to Tseung Kwan O Hospital, where he regained consciousness.
Police later contacted his wife and understood the couple had been experiencing relationship difficulties. The case is being treated as a suicide attempt. The man remains in hospital.

zh.headline: 西貢營地男子燒炭 網民報警救起
zh.dek: 警方周六凌晨接報後在大網仔營地帳幕內發現30歲男子昏迷，旁邊有燒過的炭，送院後回復清醒。
body: 警方表示，周六凌晨約零時40分接獲報案，指有人在Threads發文稱在西貢大網仔營地燒炭，並要求網民報警。
人員到場後在帳幕內發現一名30歲姓黃男子昏迷，旁邊有燒過的炭。事主被送往將軍澳醫院，其後回復清醒。
警方其後聯絡事主妻子，據了解二人有感情問題。案件列作自殺企圖處理，事主目前留院。
